title: John Allspaw Discusses Devops and Continuous Delivery
summary: This is the second in a series of interviews on continuous delivery, this time with John Allspaw, one of my co-authors on the Devops Cookbook. These interviews will eventually be put together – along with some additional exclusive material – into a set of LiveLessons, with the royalties going to Black Girls Code.

title: Value Chains and Value Streams: Strategic Maps Are Better For Project Inception
summary: I was working on some training materials this week, and I needed to whip up as-is and to-be business process maps. These would be used to help trainees visualize how the software they were going to build in an agile way during the training would transform the fictional business for which it was being written.

title: Continuous Delivery: The Case of Apple
summary: The case of Apple sometimes comes up in discussions around continuous delivery and the lean startup. title: Lean card wall: "Today" view
summary: I’ve worked with teams who have some fairly sophisticated card walls, in terms of columns (some even warranted!). For my personal card wall, I really just want an at-a-glance view for my day: just the work that I’m dealing with today, nothing more, nothing less.

title: 5 Reasons to Embrace "Cafeteria Agile"
summary: Agile enthusiasts are quick to make fun of people who pick and choose among various agile concepts, philosophies, techniques, and tools, rather than working hard to be "pure." We have a word for people who do that: dilettantes. But when we use two words we call them "cafeteria agilists."
